reuse.why: The local unlink re-writes the same db.updateAccount field-clearing block that unlinkAccount already contains instead of extracting a shared local-unlink helper from it.

duplication.why: The eight-field reset (account_id, bank, balances, sync source, sync status) is copied verbatim from unlinkAccount, and the upgradingId lookup duplicates the query already at the top of the same function.

placement.why: A function named assertBankAccountNotLinked now mutates other accounts, so a guard has become a side-effecting step and the unlink logic sits away from the unlink action.

scope.why: The change is limited to the flag, its threading through the six link functions and a release note; the extra target-existence check is minor creep.

maintainability.why: An assert that silently unlinks accounts, plus a second copy of the unlink field list that can drift from unlinkAccount, would surprise a maintainer.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in accounts/app.ts clears link fields with db.updateAccount directly instead of going through (a factored local part of) unlinkAccount

disguised_duplication.where: The copied updateAccount reset in assertBankAccountNotLinked is a verbatim copy of unlinkAccount's, not disguised
